reviews.text:
All the girls are absolutely fantastic. I took my puppy chihuahuas in for a nail clipping, and usually it'd be a battle of wills with them. My pups were at ease right away, no struggling, no fussing just calm clipping.

We'll definitely be back!

Our First dog grooming session was such a worry and were shocked at how perfectly it went! THANK YOU! Our miniature dachshund can be very anxious with separation and we tried grooming her at home with no luck whatsoever. We dropped her off at 11.30 and she was ready to collect at 12.30. Gave us enough time to get some shopping and a Starbucks at Dalmarnock. The staff are all lovely and pleasant and did exactly what we asked for. Bathed, blow dried, nails clipped and  removed the matting behind the ears. Our girl is super soft and she was so relaxed when we collected her. They even put a couple of pink bows on her ears haha! Super cute. I highly recommend to anyone and I could give 100% of my trust to this establishment. We will be seeing you again in the near future. Thanks again. See before and after photos. 👌🏼
Booked my newly rescued staffy in for a groom today, the girls done an amazing job. He is fully pampered and totally relaxed. Will definitely be a regular visit for us!!

Absolutely amazing service! Messaged them last minute as my usual groomer had let us down (long story) and the girls managed to get our 2 dogs booked in together. Unit is super secure with double door entry - knew straight away when I walked in that our doggos would be safe as. Staff are absolutely lovely and asked for an in-depth explanation of exactly what we wanted. 1 of our dogs is quite sensitive and can be hard to groom - staff were warned of this and made an exceptional job of cutting him. Went to collect both dogs and it’s the best groom we’ve had, both came out better than imagined and looked amazing.. even with it being the first groom at this groomers for both dogs. Honestly cannot fault any aspect of the groom and this has now became our usual groomer. Thanks again to everyone and see you next month 💕 x

Had a great experience with the girls in Fur-nomenal. Coco pops gets her yearly trim and they do a perfect job . They listen to what you want done. They treat her so well .  Makes me feel comfortable and her. Would highly recommend
I'm always so happy with the service the team give to Luna. They're always so happy and ready to see her when we get our monthly appointments! Loves her a good Fur-nomenal bath time 🐶 …

Brilliant dog groomers. We have been taking our cavapoo here since she was a puppy and they treat her like a princess. So caring and always flexible and helpful when making bookings. Groom always top class. Highly recommend 👍🏻 …

Been taking my very bouncy yorkie mix here for the past 4 years and consistently pleased with the quality of cut. She's always smelling fresh and enjoys the staff making a big fuss of her.

Update Feb 2025. Just picked Rosie up from groomers and as usual she is looking smart and smelling fresh. Thanks Suze for always making sure she's presentable and at ease whilst in.

I have been using the girls at Furnomonal for years now. My dog daisy, had a bad experience with a mobile groomer ( she clipped her nails and cut them) she’s been terrified since.
She is still nervous but suz and the girls genuinely care, love and give your fur babies the love they need!
Bonus is she always looks and smells amazing!
If you’re looking for somewhere that will make your dog look crackin, then this is the place!

I have been using Fur- Nonenal for the good part of two years for my Maltichon Barsa. They are an outstanding dog groomers, super friendly and very caring. Every groom that Barsa has is simply beautiful, I also like that you receive a follow up call after the groom to ensure I am happy with it. I would have no hesitation to recommend them to any dog owner, you will certainly not be disappointed nor will your dog. Muchas Gracious to everyone and I know Barsa is saying Ole Ole 🇪🇸👍😁
Great staff. Great service. Our dog went in looking like a yeti and the staff had no complaints at all. Been using them for 2 years and will continue to do so.
